data.overview: Long after Earth's plants have vanished, botanist Lowell tends a fragile forest beneath glass domes aboard a distant cargo ship, aided by two endearing robots. When orders arrive to destroy the gardens, he risks mutiny to preserve the last living seeds and the future they might restore.
data.tagline: One small forest stands between life and silence.
